name: Lookbook
summary: Responsive editorial image composition with optional captions and target-owned hotspot behavior.

anatomy.name: wideCell
anatomy.description: Item-level modifier that spans two grid columns.

anatomy.name: tallCell
anatomy.description: Item-level modifier that spans two grid rows.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional caption disclosed on hover, focus within, and non-hover input.

anatomy.name: hotspot
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned native control positioned over a cell.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting lookbook presentation; wide and tall are item layout modifiers rather than states.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Pointer emphasis and caption disclosure for one cell.

states.name: itemFocusWithin
states.description: Equivalent emphasis and caption disclosure when target-owned interactive content receives focus.

states.name: hotspotFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus when a target renders a hotspot as a native control.

behavior.name: itemOwnership
behavior.description: Targets supply ordered cell content and decide whether a cell is passive or contains native navigation.

behavior.name: hotspotOwnership
behavior.description: When a hotspot is present, the target supplies a native control, accessible name, destination or disclosure behavior, and any commerce data; canonical CSS owns presentation only.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered target-owned cells, including any item-level span, caption, or hotspot composition.

accessibility: Provide useful alternatives for informative imagery and preserve source order when cells use wide or tall visual spans.
Captions remain available on focus within and non-hover input rather than relying on pointer hover alone.
A hotspot is a native touch-sized control only when a target supplies a real action, accessible name, keyboard behavior, and destination or disclosure semantics.
Reduced motion removes pulse and image/caption transitions.
